 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LORMAN – Jackson State football is finishing up its regular season with a game at Alcorn State .
 The Tigers (7-3, 4-3 SWAC) need a win over the Braves (6-5, 4-3) at Jack Spinks-Marino Casem Stadium on Nov. 21 (2 p.m. CT, ESPN+) to have a chance to win the SWAC East and play in the SWAC Championship. They also need Mississippi Valley State to beat Alabama A&M.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This is JSU's last chance to win a true road game in SWAC play. So far, the Tigers are 0-3 on the road against SWAC opponents. Their lone conference win away from home came against AAMU at a neutral site in Mobile, Alabama.
 The Clarion Ledger is bringing you live updates, scores and highlights from the game. Follow along.
 Watch Jackson State vs Alcorn State on ESPN+ 
 Jackson State vs Alcorn State live score updates
 Jackson State vs Alcorn State history
 02:00 PM ET, November 21 2026, Tia Reid 
 Jackson State leads the all-time series 44-25-1 against Alcorn State. The Tigers have won the last two editions of the in-state rivalry game known as the Soul Bowl. The last time JSU lost to Alcorn State was at home in 2023, T.C. Taylor first season as coach. The last time JSU lost on the road was in 2018.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Week 12 SWAC schedule
 01:00 PM ET, November 21 2026, Tia Reid 
 All times CT 
 Alabama A&M at Mississippi Valley State (noon, SWAC TV)
 Jackson State at Alcorn State (2 p.m., ESPN+)
 Prairie View A&M at Alabama State (2 p.m., ESPN+)
 Arkansas-Pine Bluff at Texas Southern (2 p.m., SWAC TV)
 Florida A&M vs. Bethune-Cookman (2:30 p.m., ESPN+)
 How Jackson State can win the SWAC East
 12:00 PM ET, November 21 2026, Tia Reid 
 JSU wins the division due to tiebreakers if it beats Alcorn State and AAMU loses to MVSU.
 If the Tigers end the season in a two-way tie with the Bulldogs, JSU has the head-to-head win over AAMU and would win the division.
 If there is a three-way tie for first place between JSU, AAMU and Alabama State, JSU still wins the division.
 The first multi-team tiebreaker, head-to-head results, would not provide an answer since JSU beat AAMU, AAMU beat Alabama State and Alabama State beat JSU.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The next tiebreaker is record against division opponents. JSU is 3-2 against SWAC East teams, AAMU is 3-1, and Alabama State is 2-3. In this scenario that has AAMU losing to MVSU, the Bulldogs would finish 3-2 against the SWAC East.
 With Alabama State eliminated from the tie, the fist tiebreaker used to decide a division winner between AAMU and JSU would be head-to-head competition, which would give JSU the win.

 Jackson State vs Alcorn State prediction
 09:00 AM ET, November 21 2026, Tia Reid 
 Alcorn State 35, Jackson State 31: If this game turns into a shootout, Alcorn State has the advantage. The Tigers' offense has lacked consistency for much of the season, and even against the Braves' poor defense, it would be unexpected for the Tigers to keep up with Alcorn State's explosive offense, led by Jaylon Tolbert.
